in_marathi.name: Jagapathi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jagapathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jagat refers to the universe and Pati means Lord. Therefore, Jagapathi translates to 'Lord of the Universe'. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Shiva, who is often referred to as Mahadeva, the Great Lord.

in_bengali.name: Jagapathi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Universe
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jagapathi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Jagat refers to the universe and Pati means Lord. Therefore, Jagapathi translates to 'Lord of the Universe'. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Shiva, who is often referred to as Mahadeva, the Great Lord.
